summary: Software engineer with 7 years of experience building backend services, APIs, and LLM-powered applications. Expertise in **LLM integration**, **agentic AI development**, **Elasticsearch** search, **Java** and **Python**, **AWS**, and performance optimization.

bullets: Developed internal AI tools and products, integrating **LLMs** and automated workflows into business and engineering use cases.
Implemented a **LangGraph** workflow for AI post generation with PostgreSQL checkpoints and prompt orchestration.
Built S3-backed document ingestion for **retrieval-augmented generation**: PDF extraction, chunking and LLM summarization.
Implemented **AWS Lambda** microservices behind **API Gateway**, with CI on **ECS** containers.
Implemented cloud OIDC sign-in for short-lived CLI credentials; managed secrets with AWS Secrets Manager and Vault.
Contributed to proprietary AI IP, productizing AI capabilities into reusable solutions.
Built and managed **AWS** resources (EC2, S3, IAM) and internal developer tools, using health checks and email alerts for **observability**.

Led two **end-to-end production systems**—a call analysis SaaS platform and a trading card marketplace API—owning architecture, backend, and cloud infrastructure from design through deployment and day-to-day operation, communicating directly with the client.
Built **AI-driven transcription and insight pipelines** for call centers, adding recording-event context to **LLM** prompts.
Set up **Elasticsearch** mappings, bulk indexing and search services, refining card search with tokenized queries and indexed fields.
Cut dashboard load times from over 2 seconds to about 200 ms by fixing N+1 queries and adding indexes (**performance optimization**).
Designed automated ingestion pipelines and cron-based synchronization of card data and prices, with retries.
Provisioned GCP resources with **Terraform**: Cloud Run, MySQL, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub and Speech-to-Text.
Wrote end-to-end tests to prevent UI regressions; monitored production with health checks and Slack alerts.
Used **RabbitMQ** and asynchronous workers for event-driven call processing; built REST APIs aggregating pricing data.
Adopted **AI-driven development** with **Claude Code**; managed **GCP** with **Terraform** and **CI/CD pipelines**.
Collaborated with leadership to design and automate the HR system infrastructure, eliminating tens of hours of weekly reporting.
Managed GitLab repositories and **CI/CD pipelines** for internal employee services.
Developed reusable **internal tools** and libraries with standardized interfaces, streamlining development and reducing boilerplate.
Built backend service APIs with **Java**, **Spring Boot** and **Spring**; developed **Python** microservices with **Flask** for the bank.
Rebuilt legacy banking **REST API** services and modernized legacy banking applications using **Angular/Ionic** and **Express**.
Built secure login for a cross-platform mobile banking app—challenge authentication, OTP login, and **session management**.
Established test environments and wrote **unit** and **end-to-end** tests to meet the banking client's **90% test coverage** requirement.
Provided **technical leadership** through training and developer support; led UI architecture for a **React** proof of concept.
**Saved QA teams hundreds of hours weekly** with **Python** scripts that parse phone IVR banking logs, replacing manual searches.
Worked in **Agile** teams to define and implement user stories and tasks across client engagements.
Open source maintainer of **23 applications**, **7 API services**, **13 Docker images** and **4 npm packages**.
Design and run **agentic coding workflows** with **Claude Code**, with custom skills and **AI guardrails** for unattended agent runs.
Integrated multiple **LLM** providers with streaming chat; built guardrails validating AI-generated resume edits.
Built **Fastify** microservices on Fly.io with **OpenAPI** docs and async email delivery over **RabbitMQ** with dead-letter queues.
Provision and operate **cloud infrastructure** with **Terraform**; build **CI/CD pipelines** with **GitHub Actions**.
